title: Ferrell Carter Road Tract
summary: 181± acres of managed timber and wildlife habitat 13 miles outside Baxley, with food plots, planted pine, hardwood creek buffers and county road frontage.
bullets: 181± acres approximately 13 miles outside Baxley, Georgia
Well-managed food plots established throughout the tract
Planted pine timber with mature hardwood buffers along the creeks
Multiple creeks and natural water features for wildlife
Extensive interior road system providing access across the property
County road frontage on Ferrell Carter Road
